translations.web: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
